ios.desc:
DockerTab puts your Docker host in your pocket. Monitor and control containers directly from your iPhone, whether you're on the same network or halfway around the world.

CONTAINER MANAGEMENT (FREE)
• Start, stop, restart, and pause containers with one tap
• View container status and last 100 lines of logs
• LAN mode — connect directly on your local network, no cloud involved

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Remote relay access — connect from anywhere, fully encrypted
• Multiple agents — manage more than one Docker host
• Live stats — real-time CPU, memory, network, and disk I/O graphs
• Live log streaming — like docker logs -f, from your phone
• Push notifications when containers start, stop, or restart
• Interactive shell — run commands inside any container
• Docker Compose management — deploy, edit, and manage stacks
• Browse Docker images and volumes
• Dark mode
• Home screen widgets

SETUP
Install the free DockerTab agent on your Docker host:
docker pull ghcr.io/191855/dockertab-agent:latest
Full docs: https://github.com/191855/dockertab-agent

Scan the QR code from the app logs and you're connected. No port forwarding required.

PREMIUM
Available as a monthly subscription, annual plan (save 40%), or one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use: https://dockertab.app/terms.html

quotes.text:
I built DockerTab to give developers a way to monitor and control their Docker hosts directly from their phones. You can start/stop containers, view live logs, and access the terminal without needing port forwarding.

    The iOS app is available now: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dockertab/id6759782246
    
    The Android version is currently in the testing phase. 

    I'd love to hear your feedback at support@dockertab.app
